d.t: ROAD MARKER FOR GRASS AND GRAVEL PAVER MODULES
d.s: SikaRoof TurfPave Marker is a white road marker designed to demarcate temporary or permanent spaces atop grass or gravelled areas. Marker modules are manufactured from polypropylene (PP) are available in white, with other colours subject to availability. SikaRoof TurfPave Marker are push-fitted into any cell on SikaRoof TurfPave XD.
a: White markers to demarcate areas or create floor signage
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Markers are used as to create temporary or permanent spaces such as parking lots or form floor signages on top of grass or gravelled areas
d.pk: SikaRoof TurfPave Marker Refer to pricelist

sec.t: Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No. SGBP 3255
No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet

Product must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements
SikaRoof TurfPave Marker is push-fitted into pre-determined cells of SikaRoof TurfPave XD to create the desired design according to specifications.
